title: doellingeria elegans
intro: Doellingeria elegans, commonly known as Elderberry or Flat-topped Elder, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate cold and flu symptoms, as well as other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Doellingeria elegans include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, making it a popular natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
